meta.title: Frequently asked questions | Intello
meta.description: What Intello manages, how you keep control of the process, how we start, what drives the cost and how we look after your data.

header.title: What clients ask us
header.lede: Answers for leadership, operations, finance and technology. If yours is not here, write to us.

items.question: What does Intello do?
answer: We manage operational and back-office processes for logistics companies: shipment Control Tower, outsourced billing, inventory audits, and data and reporting.
Every process runs on a documented SOP, with defined owners and reporting.

items.question: Is Intello a logistics company?
answer: No. We do not move or store cargo. We are the operational extension of logistics companies: we run their processes so they can focus on growing.

items.question: Which companies do you work with?
answer: Freight forwarders, 3PL operators, couriers and freight companies with tracking, document, billing or data processes that can run remotely.

items.question: Is this the same as hiring staff?
answer: No. We do not sell headcount: you hire a service with method, quality and visibility.
We define the scope, SOP, RACI matrix and metrics with you, and we keep your way of serving your clients.

items.question: Who does the work and how do I keep control?
answer: Every activity has an owner, approver, consulted and informed party in a RACI matrix across your team, your suppliers, your agents and Intello.
You follow progress on dashboards, recurring reports and the status we upload to your portals. You approve the key documents.

items.question: What happens when something deviates?
answer: Scheduled status sweeps and automatic triggers catch the deviation; we tell you at once and escalate it through the RACI.
Structural change requests go through an analysis phase before implementation is committed.

items.question: Do you work in my systems?
answer: Yes. We work in your tools and portals, and we bring together reports from your systems, suppliers and tracking platforms with ETL. We define the detail when we map the process.

items.question: Where do you operate and which routes do you cover?
answer: We are a remote team in Latin America, on a nearshore model.
Our Control Tower connects 35 countries: origins in Asia, North America, South America and Europe into Central America, the Caribbean and the Andean region.

items.question: How do we start?
answer: Book a 30-minute review of one specific process: volume, systems and pain points.
We return a process map with a draft SOP, RACI and success metrics. If it makes sense, we run that process as a pilot and take on the next one when the numbers prove it.

items.question: How much does it cost?
answer: It depends on scope, volume and service level. We design tiers that range from operational control to co-governance with you.
We share the proposal privately, after we evaluate your process.

items.question: How do you look after my data?
answer: With centralized role-based access, scheduled backups, a record of every action and separation between operations and technology. We work under your data processing agreements.
SOC 2 Type II certification is a goal on our roadmap, not a current certification. On this site we only collect what you send through the contact form.

items.question: Do you use artificial intelligence?
answer: We use technology to run things better: automated ETL, alerts, dashboards and automated reports.
We are building conversational logistics so you can query your operation by talking to your own data; it is not available yet.
